info.name: Lukeflow — Capability Forms API
info.description:
Form definitions + instances served by luke-capability-engine.

Run top-to-bottom. Folder 0 sets up FORMS access (subscribe tenant + grant the test user);
forms routes are gated by the FORMS capability (GET=read, mutations=read-write).

Each request feeds the next via collection variables. Base URL = local capability-engine :8082.

item.name: 0 · Access setup
item.description: Forms routes require FORMS access: the tenant must be subscribed AND the user granted. Run this first.

item.name: 1 · Definitions
item.description: Create, read, edit and save the working draft of a form definition.

item.name: 2 · Versioning
item.description: Check-in compiles the draft into an immutable version; first auto-publishes.

item.name: 3 · Resolve (for renderer / engine)
item.description: What a renderer or a process formKey resolves: the schema (pinned) and the field→variable contract.

item.name: 4 · Instances (runtime)
item.description: A concrete runtime occurrence: create (pins the published version), prefill, save, submit, mark processed.

item.name: 5 · Access control
item.description: Forms routes are gated by the FORMS capability: GET needs read, mutations need read-write.

item.name: 6 · Guards & negative cases
item.description: Tenant isolation, gated identity, and state-machine guards. (Enforcement now returns 401 for missing identity and 403 for no grant in the tenant.)

item.name: 7 · Retire & Trash
item.description: Retire keeps the form resolvable; delete trashes it; purge removes it. Purge is last — it deletes the test form.
